_about: Stan's watchlist: the pain phrases the fetcher searches Hacker News for.
Each phrase is searched as an exact phrase. weight is how often a match
is a real software pain (1.0 nearly always, 0.5 about half the time) - a
starting guess, to be tuned from what the owner approves and rejects.
Volumes are the last 30 days on 2026-10-14, measured, not guessed.
The settings below the list are read by stan.py; change them here.
